part.text:
Fixed in `internal/terraform/transform_attach_config_resource.go`.

The transformer now indexes removed blocks by absolute module path and attaches them even when the referenced child module no longer exists in configuration, so destroy-time provisioners in `removed` blocks run for module resources.

Validated:
- `TestContext2Apply_provisionerDestroyRemoved`
- Full `./internal/terraform` suite
- `./internal/configs`, `./internal/refactoring`, `./internal/addrs`
